Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression redundantly combines a historical time noun with a time-of construction. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，a location phrase follows the verb directly; the aspect marker cannot appear before the preposition. [teacher rule: le_placement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 祭拜了：祭拜，this is a daily routine, so it takes the zero aspect particle rather than 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孟子搬家，跟 means “together with,” while 带着 expresses that the mother takes her child along when moving. [vocab list]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，了 follows the verb plus its directional/resultative element, as in 搬到 + 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，别的 distinguishes other items from a previously specified one, while 另一个 means one additional or different city. [teacher rule: bieren]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母住：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈住，孟子 is appearing for the first time, so introduce him clearly before using family labels; after that, 他 can refer back to him. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子才五岁：他才五岁，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other child competes as the referent, so use a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 is already the subject earlier in the same sentence, so a pronoun avoids unnecessarily repeating the name. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
10. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。：，所以他们搬到了另一个城市找工作。The move is the result of not finding work and lacking money, so use 所以 to show the cause-and-effect relation. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a historical time, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
住在 takes the location directly, and 了 cannot occur between 住 and 在.
每天 describes a routine, so the action should use zero aspect rather than completed 了.
孟母跟孩子搬家 is an acceptable way to say that the mother and child moved together; 带着孟子 is only an alternative wording.
The directional complement must precede 了, so 搬到了 is correct.
别一个城市 is not the appropriate expression here; 另一个城市 correctly means another city.
孟子 is a first-mentioned character and should be introduced clearly before later reference to him.
孩子 is vague after Mengzi has been named, while 他 can clearly refer back to him in this immediate context.
孟母 has just been established in the same sentence, so 她 is the appropriate close reference.
A connector is not required here, and the proposed correction begins with a comma plus 所以 without showing its preceding cause.
